name: swipe-toast

frames.best_why: One toast is fully lit with title, description, Undo button and the orange fuse line beneath it.

tagline: Dark notice slides in low, with a thin orange fuse burning down to dismissal.
summary: A compact dark toast for the corner of the screen. It holds a title, a short line, an Undo button and a glowing orange line that shrinks as its timer runs out; it can be swiped down or closed with Escape.
appearance: A charcoal rounded card holding a bold title, a muted description and a small light Undo pill, with a thin orange hairline along its bottom edge. It floats over a black stage above a light Archive file button.
behaviour: The toast rises into view, then its orange fuse shrinks steadily from one end while hover or focus pauses it. Swiping it down throws it off-screen, and Escape or the Undo button dismisses it early.
demo_content: Repeated "Q3-report.pdf archived" toast with a "Moved to Archive" line, Undo and an Archive file button.
search_phrases: notification that fades away on its own
snackbar that shrinks as it waits
floating status card with orange line
use_when: A file or form action succeeds and the page needs a small confirmation with a short window to undo.
avoid_when: Its timer can run out before someone reads it, and the fixed-corner version covers page content on small screens.
customise: Title, description, icon, action label, colours, width, radius, fuse position, duration and hover pause are props; the dismiss logic stays in the source.
weight_why: One card, a spring on drag and a single browser animation for the fuse.

a11y.note: The card is a polite live region and Escape closes it, but there is no visible focus ring and swiping has no keyboard equivalent.

polish_why: Crisp card and a clear fuse metaphor; the description and fuse are both low contrast on charcoal.
